apply_to_each_frame: apply an image augmentation function to each frame of a video and reassemble with audio
apply_to_frames: apply an image augmentation function combining frames from two separate videos into one output
apply_cv2_augmenter: apply a CV2-based video augmenter to a video file and save the augmented result
get_image_kwargs: get a dictionary with an image directory path and its listed image files
review_utils: review the video utility functions for frame extraction, augmentation, and reassembly patterns
